baseline.policy: All 236 participate in R4 while previous 58 are supplemented in parallel. Only reliably demonstrated severe, chronic, unavoidable residential environmental-health exposure can hard-exclude. Missingness is PENDING not failure. No county-level blanket exclusion for localizable hazards.

completed_assets.source: CHAP annual PM2.5 and ozone 2000-2025, WorldPop-weighted county model proxies

running_jobs.scope: 236 candidates / 13 provinces / 61 municipal code groups / eight industrial industry codes
running_jobs.rule: Limited pages and company samples must be labeled partial, never treated as a full city or county census.
